name: Mitani Naoma
source:
[url=/c10479]Rikuto's[/url] father and [url=/c12077]Ayumu's[/url] stepfather. He manages a bakery and his baking skills are top-notch. He loves strawberries over anything and has even stated that "strawberries are justice". Seven years before the story begins, his wife Ikumi died and he was forced to raise Rikuto all by himself. However in the process, he found [url=/c54523]Ryouko[/url], fell in love with her and later decided to marry her.
